verdict.rationale: Digits can be automated without a UI through the Connect API. It offers batch transaction sync with idempotent external_id writes, on-demand financial statements, bills workflow endpoints, webhooks, and OpenAPI-based client generation. A free, resettable per-developer demo instance suits automated testing. However, auth is documented only as the OAuth 2.0 authorization-code grant, which needs interactive user consent, and there is no CLI or CI-specific guidance. Missing for 10: non-interactive machine-to-machine auth (client credentials, service accounts or API keys), an official CLI or headless runner, documented CI/pipeline usage, and independent hands-on corroboration.
